liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- Phil's performance on this song is highlighted as a standout moment [14]
- The long, drawn-out Eyes of the World jam is cited as inspired [15]
- The space funk riff in this song rivals Parliament and prototypes the Shakedown lick [18]

## The recordings

- **gd74-09-18.sbd.miller.20732.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 26 songs; 209 min; rated 4.78/5 by 27 [1]. Said about its sound: The playing is described as very tight and exciting with no weak tracks; Bass is strong, but vocals are initially weak until the band finds itself; The middle offering is preferred; the first has lower guitar, the third hollow vocals [7][8][9][10][15]
- **gd74-09-18.sbd.bertha-ashley.21925.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 26 songs; 209 min; rated 4.77/5 by 13 [3]. Said about its sound: The recording is crystal clear with tight band chemistry; The sound is missing something in the midrange but is better than the 9/20/74 show [16][17]
- **gd1974-09-18.sbd.miller.20675.shnf**: soundboard; 26 songs; 209 min; rated 4.75/5 by 20 [2]
- **gd1974-09-18.sbd.jeffm.3398.shnf**: soundboard; 24 songs; 178 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]

## Around the show

- Jerry starts both sets, which the reviewer notes as a clue [7]
- The Bertha re-master is considered a far superior sound source than this recording [11]
- The first disc's polish is compared to the first disc from 11/11/73 [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd74-09-18.sbd.miller.20732.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [1]
- **gd74-09-18.sbd.bertha-ashley.21925.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]
- **gd1974-09-18.sbd.miller.20675.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Rm -> Dat -> Sonic Solutions -> CD -> EAC -> SHN [2]
- **gd1974-09-18.sbd.jeffm.3398.shnf**: transferred by DAE(EAC) and SHN Encoding By Jeff M.; source: SBD>MR>?>DAT>CDR>EAC>SHN [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by @donelichterman: [Don’s Pick This Week is from the Parc des Expositions on 09-19-1974 - The Grateful Dead Live](https://thegratefuldeadlive.com/dons-pick-this-week-uis-from-the-parc-des-expositions-on-09-19-1974/) [20]
